target_customer: Mobile app publishers and growth marketers who want push notification campaigns without engineering work
problem: Mobile apps struggle to run effective push notification marketing because it needs SDK work and lifecycle managers. nGrow connected to behavioral data in Amplitude, Firebase and Mixpanel to set up automatic push campaigns in hours.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription, pricing not found

founders.name: Alex Sergeev
founders.background_notes: Analytics and marketing advisor to 30+ mobile products and marketing and analytics director at an Eastern European tech company, per the YC page. Education not listed.

founders.name: Marat Zhanabekov
founders.background_notes: Head of Growth and Analytics at Donut Lab and growth analytics at Scentbird per the YC page; Master's in Computer Science per the nGrow about page.

competitors.name: OneSignal
competitors.what: Push notification market leader, later adding email, SMS and in-app
competitors.traction_then: Described as market leader in push; HubSpot invested in 2021
competitors.funding_then: HubSpot investment in 2021, amount undisclosed; US$25M Series B earlier

competitors.name: MoEngage
competitors.what: Omnichannel customer engagement platform including push
competitors.traction_then: Customer base and recurring revenue doubled between July 2020 and July 2021 per its raise coverage

technical_complexity.rationale: Ingesting behavioral events from several analytics tools and optimizing campaign targeting and timing with models is standard data engineering with some hard parts.

defensibility.rationale: Integrations with analytics stacks add some lock in, but the category has large established vendors and the wedge was easy to copy.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Incumbents kept widening into multichannel engagement; no source shows a direct copy or acquisition of nGrow.

market_need_then: Push notifications were a core retention channel for mobile apps and established vendors were raising capital in 2021. The company claims up to 30 percent incremental revenue lift, which is its own unverified claim.

branding.domain_note: Uses ngrow.ai, a .ai domain, not an exact .com.

identity.voice_and_tone: Benefit led marketing claims such as 4x cheaper than in-house and plus 5 to 10 percent revenue

brand_strength.rationale: A clear grow-themed name and an active blog and case studies, but no press about the brand itself or community evidence was found.

outcome_analysis: nGrow joined YC in Winter 2022 and closed a reported US$2.3M seed in December 2022. The YC directory marks it Inactive, but the company website was live with blog posts into 2024 and had broadened from push to email and push campaigns. No shutdown, acquisition or layoff report was found, so the cause of the inactive status is not public and failure factors stay empty.
notes: The US$2.3M seed is from a December 21, 2022 press release seen only in search snippets (the page returned 403 on fetch) and a Seedtable entry. The US$0.5M convertible note on 2022-03-29 rests on CB Insights alone. A TechBullion interview mentions a 1.5M seed and Caplight lists US$3.1M total, which do not reconcile with 0.5M plus 2.3M. YC says founded 2020; another source says 2021. Site shows email and push, an expansion with no date. Exit type unknown although YC marks Inactive.
